# 🐛 Bug-fix PR

---

## 📌 Summary
Fixed SQLite migration failure in `r2b3c4d5e6f7_add_prompt_namespacing_fields.py` caused by constraint operations outside of batch mode.

## 🐞 Root Cause
Lines 141 and 154 used `op.create_unique_constraint()` and `op.drop_constraint()` outside of `batch_alter_table` context, which SQLite doesn't support.

## 💡 Fix Description
Moved all constraint operations inside `batch_alter_table` blocks (lines 136-141 for upgrade, 155-165 for downgrade), enabling Alembic's copy-and-move strategy for SQLite while maintaining PostgreSQL compatibility.
